description: This file contains unit tests for the CronJobEditor component in a SwiftUI application. It tests various aspects like building the editor for new and existing jobs, UI components such as StatusPill, and behaviors related to delete-after-run scheduling.

classes.name: CronJobEditorSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of SwiftUI unit tests for verifying the behavior and UI of CronJobEditor component.

methods.name: makeEditor
methods.description: Creates an instance of CronJobEditor for testing, with optional job and channelsStore parameters.

methods.name: status pill builds body
methods.description: Tests that the StatusPill UI component correctly builds its body with different status types.

methods.name: cron job editor builds body for new job
methods.description: Verifies that the CronJobEditor renders correctly when creating a new job.

methods.name: cron job editor builds body for existing job
methods.description: Verifies that the CronJobEditor renders correctly for an existing scheduled job.

methods.name: cron job editor exercises builders
methods.description: Runs tests that exercise internal builder functions of the CronJobEditor.

methods.name: cron job editor includes delete after run for at schedule
methods.description: Tests the logic related to setting the delete-after-run property for a scheduled cron job.
